The match was played on 24 May 2025 at the [[Stade de France]] in [[Saint-Denis, Seine-Saint-Denis|Saint-Denis]].{{cite news |last1=Myers |first1=Paul |title=Dembélé bags a brace as PSG overpower Dunkerque to reach Coupe de France final |url=https://www.rfi.fr/en/sports/20250401-demb%C3%A9l%C3%A9-bags-a-brace-as-psg-overpower-dunkerque-to-reach-coupe-de-france-final |work=[[Radio France Internationale|RFI]] |publisher=[[France Médias Monde]] |date=1 April 2025 |language=en}} Paris Saint-Germain won the match 3–0 for their record-extending 16th Coupe de France title. ==Background== Paris Saint-Germain won the Coupe de France a record 15 times and is trying to repeat as the previous year's champions to extend the record to sixteen and repeat [[Double (association football)|the double]].{{cite news |last1=Pugmire |first1=Jerome |title=Paris Saint-Germain reaches French Cup final by rallying past Dunkerque 4-2 |url=https://www.thestar.com/sports/soccer/paris-saint-germain-reaches-french-cup-final-by-rallying-past-dunkerque-4-2/article_4eb2f2fb-a683-50ec-b15f-7682e0c67060.html |work=[[Toronto Star]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=1 April 2025 |language=en}} Reims won the Coupe de France twice, last playing in the final in 1977.{{cite news |title=Reims reaches French Cup final by beating
